name: agent_team
description: Route a task to a specialised role and run it on the real backend that role owns: Researcher uses the live web-research capability, Analyst and Planner use the configured model, Code Reviewer reads and reviews a real file, Automation runs gated desktop steps. The Developer role refuses to write code from inside a plugin — that must go through the coding tool so the change is approval-gated — and says so instead of pretending.

role.description: researcher | analyst | planner | code_reviewer | automation | developer

steps.description: JSON steps for the automation role.

settings.label: Reasoning model
settings.help: Model used by the Analyst and Planner roles. Blank uses the app default.

settings.label: Review excerpt size
settings.help: How much of a file to send to the reviewer.
